$comment: Where agb skill install writes the skill, and how agents are detected (docs/SPEC.md §13.3). Paths start with ~ (the user's home) or are relative to the project directory. Check each agent's docs before a release and update 'checked'.

agents.name: Codex CLI
agents.note: Codex reads user skills from ~/.agents/skills and repository skills from .agents/skills.

agents.name: Gemini CLI
agents.note: ~/.agents/skills is an alias of ~/.gemini/skills and takes precedence over it.

agents.name: Cursor
agents.note: Cursor also reads ~/.claude/skills, so it can list the skill twice; the copies are identical.
